results.statement: global_dependency_ownership must offer a config setting that restricts its check to src/**/*.rs, the source-only scope atm-core's checker uses.
results.quote:
The released 0.8.2 `global_dependency_ownership` policy has no source-only scope equivalent to the atm-core consumer check.
[…]
The previous atm-core checker passes on this tree because it scans `src/**/*.rs` and does not treat separate integration-test targets as production source. There is no config setting to preserve that source-only scope. atm-core therefore retains this rule locally pending a released source-only scope; no roots or excludes were added to suppress the findings.
results.context: Issue acceptance text: sc-lint#136 comment 2026-10-29 (re-registered from GH-136.src-only.2, ID-only change)
results.deterministic_check: Boundary test reproducing the #136 tree: the seven crates/*/tests/ findings disappear under the setting and crates/atm/src/commands/mod.rs is still reported.

criteria.unclear: The work area is too vague to determine whether dependency-ownership scope is touched.
criteria.yes: The item changes, investigates, configures, or tests global_dependency_ownership / SCB-MANIFEST-004 or its source-file scope.

relevant.instructions: Would completing the activity in `item.text` touch global_dependency_ownership, SCB-MANIFEST-004, or the policy selection of source files? Evaluate relevance alone.

criteria.no: The item is wholly silent on source-only scope, explicitly rejects or defers the setting, or substitutes roots/excludes/disabling or a mode including integration tests.
criteria.unclear: Source-only scope is discussed or investigated, but the text leaves the status of the required configurable setting unresolved.
criteria.yes: The delivered account says it supplied a global_dependency_ownership config setting selecting checks limited to src/**/*.rs, excluding integration-test targets.

criteria.no: No incompatible decision is stated; silence, investigation, and missing detail alone are not conflict.

criteria.yes: The item explicitly rejects the setting, substitutes roots/excludes/disabling for it, or requires integration-test targets in the supposed source-only mode.

violated.instructions: Is there an explicit incompatible alternative in `item.text` to the source-only setting required by ANC-029? Silence is allowed for this judgment; substituting suppression or scanning integration tests in that mode is incompatible.
